title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
Iceland 4x4 Adventure, Season Preview, Cool Products
Transports viewers to remote locations while showcasing the latest gear and accessories that make the modern overland lifestyle so popular and appealing.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
S02 E02 — Colorado Dirt bike Tour, Riding Snowbikes in Montana / Cherokee Toy Hauler Test
The team travels to Montana to go snow biking in this winter paradise, then heads to Colorado to go on an unforgettable dirt bike tour. We also test a Cherokee Gray Wolf Black Label 22RRBL toy hauler and take it on a cross-country road trip.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
S02 E03 — Rocky Mountain Jeep Adventure, Flagstaff Overland Expo, Beta 430RR Test
We travel to the world-famous Rocky Mountains to go on a scenic Jeep tour with a bunch of volunteers that keep our trails open. We also hit the Flagstaff Overland Expo and test Beta's 430RR dual-sport motorcycle.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
St. Thomas & St. John UTV Adventure, Trailside Gourmet Food, Honda CRF450RL Test
We hit St. Thomas and St. John to explore this tropical paradise in UTVs. Our crew also goes off-grid with Jesse Houston to learn about gourmet camp cooking with his Switchback Supper Club, then test Honda's CRF450RL dual-sport motorcycle.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
Honda Talon UTV Test / Colorado Dirt Bike Tour, Beta Alp X test
The team travels to Montana to test a pair of Honda Talon UTVs, then Ken Faught and Randy Commons head to Colorado to ride adventure bikes. We also test Beta's all-new Alp X dual-sport motorcycle.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
S02 E06 — Idaho Dirt Bike Tour, Oregon Overland Expo, Silver Kings Hard Enduro adventure
Our Ken Faught and crew head to Idaho to ride dirt bikes at the world-famous Gold Creek Lodge, then hit the Silver Kings Hard Enduro to see what this sport is all about. We top it off with a trip to the Oregon Overland Expo to check out new products.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
S02 E07 — Kauai Overland, Costa Rica Dirt Bike & UTV Adventure, Yamaha Tenere Test
Our Ken Faught and Viola Bautista go overlanding on the Garden Island of Kauai. Our team also rides dirt bikes and drives UTVs in Costa Rica and tests Yamaha's impressive 700cc Tenere adventure bike.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
S02 E08 — Moab Off-Road Adventure, Chase Gardender Solo Traveler, Beta X-Trainer Test
We head to Utah to go on an incredible off-road adventure in the world-famous Moab trail system. We also introduce you to solo traveler Chas Gardener and test Beta's impressive X-Trainer dirt bike.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
1200-mile Dirt Bike Tour to the Arctice Ocean, Colorado UTV adventure, Bonnell bikes
Our Ken Faught makes a 1200-mile trek to the Arctic Circle on a motorcycle, then heads to Colorado for an unforgettable UTV adventure. We also test Bonnell electric bikes and KYB's all-new truck suspension.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
S02 E10 — Hawaii UTV Tour, Montana dirt bike adventure, Nobo 10.7 Overland Trailer Test
Viola Bautista and Catherina Bertolino join Ken Faught at the famous Kipu Ranch in Hawaii to experience a UTV tour; we also head to Montana for a dirt bike adventure and test the No Boundaries 10.7 Overland Trailer built by Forest River.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
S02 E11 — Utah 4x4 Adventure, Inside Far Out Camping Co., Honda Transalp Test
We head to Utah to go off-grid with an X-Games gold medalist who is also an amputee. We also test Far Out Camping Co.'s unique rig in Oregon and tell you all about Honda's Transalp adventure bike.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
S02 E12 — Arizona Off-Road Adventure, Baja UTV test, Sun Lite 14 THX Trailer feature
We head to Baja to test a race UTV, then head to Arizona for another incredible off-road adventure. Our crew also tests Sun Lite's 14 THX toy hauler trailer. This is a cool concept that offers so much versatility.

title: Off-Road Travel TV
description:
Off-Road Travel TV - Jeep Project, Custom Van Build, Bali Off-Road Adventure
Our crew builds two project vehicles including a Jeep Wrangler and Mercedes Sprinter Vans. These are loaded with high-tech gadgets. We also head to Bali for unique off-road adventure and the sights will leave you breathless.
